The likely focus is on honor, desire, and complicity as private grudges and colonial business interests push a community toward moral and personal reckoning. Don Luisito arrives to toast the voyage and clumsily court Marieta, drawing a protective rebuke from her father. The ship is blessed, farewells are tearful, and Grabat sails.
